original_objective: Clean the raw 2024 smart-meter export and analyse electricity consumption: total and per-building-type usage, the quarterly trend, the change between the first and second half of the year, tariff and meter usage, commercial load on hot days and the distribution of consumption and temperature, then report the verified findings to business stakeholders.

cleaning.cleaning_logic: Reads raw.csv entirely as text, trims whitespace, and normalizes the configured missing tokens to NA. It removes later duplicate reading_id values first, then enforces non-missing reading_id. Dates are accepted only in the five specified formats and rewritten as YYYY-MM-DD; meter_id is uppercased; building_type and tariff are mapped to the allowed canonical values with invalid/missing rows dropped. Energy has commas removed, handles optional kWh/MWh units with MWh converted to kWh, drops missing/non-numeric/out-of-range values, and rounds to 2 decimals. Temperature removes trailing degree/unit markers, converts Fahrenheit to Celsius, rounds to 1 decimal, and sets missing/non-numeric/out-of-range temperatures to empty while keeping the row. The output contains exactly the required columns sorted by reading_id, plus cleaning_summary.json with row and per-rule counts.
